summary: Scans a linked list (head at this[4], node count at this[7]) to find the index of the node whose string matches a2, using sub_566810 for comparison. Returns the matching index, or -1 when a2 is null, the list is empty, or no node matches. Null node strings fall back to the global byte_5EA438 before comparison.

operations.description: Initialize the result to -1 (not found) before any validation.
Guard on a2 being non-null; a null search string returns -1 immediately.
Read the list node count from this[7] and bail when it is not positive.
Iterate candidate indices starting at 0, validating each index against the stored count at this[7].
Load the list head from this[4] and walk forward via the next pointer at node+0x4 to reach the requested index.
Dereference the node data pointer to obtain the node string; when the string pointer is null, fall back to byte_5EA438.
Compare the candidate node string against a2 via sub_566810.
Return the current index when the string comparison succeeds.
Return -1 when the index runs past the stored count without a match.

clean_pseudocode: for (int step = idx; node && step > 0; --step) node = *(int *)(node + 4);
